cases.name: cold release has one physical production
cases.expectation: one successful producer creates one shared release identity

cases.name: warm release reuses eligible payloads
cases.expectation: warm reuse publishes and validates a release without repeated eligible materialization

cases.name: concurrent consumers share one release
cases.expectation: three requesting consumers join one artifact ID and release digest

cases.name: digest corruption is rejected before use
cases.expectation: a published payload mutation fails integrity validation before the check body

cases.name: inventory mismatch is rejected before use
cases.expectation: an unmanifested file cannot enter a consumer check body

cases.name: wrong source SHA is scoped to the requesting consumer
cases.expectation: a release from another source revision is rejected

cases.name: wrong recursive pin is rejected
cases.expectation: a release with another recursive submodule pin is rejected

cases.name: incompatible environment is rejected
cases.expectation: an incompatible consumer environment cannot use the release

cases.name: producer failure is terminal
cases.expectation: a failed producer cannot be substituted by a consumer rebuild

cases.name: post-publication mutation is not accepted as warm reuse
cases.expectation: mutation after publication invalidates the immutable release
